name: Rano Kau crater and Orongo
region: Rapa Nui National Park, Easter Island
why: From the edge of Hanga Roa up through the forest to the rim of a crater lake 1.6 km wide, and on to the birdman village of Orongo above the sea cliffs and the motu islets.
book: Rapa Nui National Park ticket (US$80 for foreigners) and an accredited Ma'u Henua guide, required for park visits; Orongo can be entered only once per ticket. Park open 09:00-18:00 (to 19:00 December-March).
water: None after the last houses of Hanga Roa: carry 1.5-2 litres.
dangers: The Rano Kau cliffs are crumbling: keep back from the crater and sea edges.
Sun and wind on the open rim; the forest path is slippery after rain.
turnaround: Not at the crater viewpoint by 15:00: look at the lake and walk back, Orongo is another 40 minutes there and back.

points.name: Mataveri trailhead, Hanga Roa
points.note: At the south end of Hanga Roa, past the airport runway's western end: the path leaves the road and climbs into the forest.

points.name: Rano Kau crater viewpoint
points.note: Top of the path, about 300 m up: the crater with its reed-covered lake far below, the sea beyond the broken southern wall.

points.name: Orongo ceremonial village
points.note: Stone houses and birdman petroglyphs on the rim, facing Motu Nui and Motu Iti. Back the same way.
